Nil NA 4.6% During the year, the Company continued investing in energy- efficient and environmentally sustainable technologies to improve operational performance while reducing its environmental footprint. Key initiatives included electrolyzer recoating and membrane replacement, Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs), energy-efficient compressors, cooling water pump upgrades, chiller optimization, and high-efficiency cooling tower fan assemblies, all of which enhance energy efficiency, lower electricity consumption, and contribute to the reduction of indirect GHG emissions. The Company also strengthened air and water stewardship through the upgrade of ESP for improved particulate emission control, cooling water optimization projects, and reactor automation using on/off cooling water valves to reduce freshwater consumption and wastewater generation. Additionally, waste heat recovery from screw compressors and process efficiency improvements under the RVCM capacity enhancement project support resource optimization and reduced environmental impact per unit of production. These Capital investments demonstrate the Company’s commitment to adopting cleaner technologies, improving resource efficiency, enhancing air quality, conserving water, and reducing its overall carbon footprint, while supporting safer and more sustainable manufacturing operations.
